What is that? 

You're lucky. I've never had PFG-03M that *wasn't* fogged.

posts.author: MarkCavin
posts.content_md:
It is my little soap rock owl, medusas owl . I have 3 of these plates left and most had fogging in the corners with few exceptions. I did notice one weird thing, one image had profound white streak across the center and after drying it completely faded away and an excellent hologram appeared; very weird. The owl is very bright and the plate was lighted for the photograph with only a simple GE 60W light bulb and no camera flash. I gave this one to a coworker. I just noticed I have given away all my holograms and I only have 2 4x5 left. Better get into the lab. Overall my impression of the 03 series is that it is very good stuff, but a bit cranky.

Mark
